summary: Cotton tower near the village of Cotton, Saint Louis County; a 1937 CCC build per a local history page and a photo caption; reportedly auctioned; still listed standing.

facts.design: Four-legged steel tower with an enclosed observation platform at the top

events.note: Erected by the Civilian Conservation Corps as a steel tower about 100 feet high
Photo caption (uploaded 8 August 2011) says the tower and its forestry station were auctioned off a few years earlier; no sale date or buyer given

evidence.supports: about two miles west of the village of Cotton
evidence.quote: THE STATION IS LOCATED ABOUT 2 MILES WEST OF THE VILLAGE OF COTTON.

evidence.supports: four-legged steel structure about 100 feet high with an enclosed observation platform
evidence.quote: IT IS A 4 LEGGED STEEL STRUCTURE, APPROXIMATELY 100 FEET HIGH AND WITH AN ENCLOSED OBSERVATION PLATFORM AT THE TOP.

evidence.supports: station description is from the National Geodetic Survey

evidence.quote: 1937: The Civilian Conservation Corps erected a 100-foot steel tower.
Erected in 1937 by the CCC the Cotton tower and forestry station was auctioned off a few years ago.

evidence.supports: located in the Cloquet Valley State Forest

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The lookout list marks the tower standing. The Commons caption reports an auction of the tower and forestry station, but gives no later status or owner. The tower is recorded as standing; ownership after the sale is unconfirmed.

sources.title: Cotton - Forest Lookouts
sources.publisher: Forest Lookouts (centraluslookouts.weebly.com), reproducing a National Geodetic Survey station description

notes_for_editor: The 1937 CCC build rests on a local history page that reproduces a federal survey station description, and on a 2011 Commons caption that repeats it. No independent CCC or DNR record was found. No National Historic Lookout Register page for Cotton was in the cache (two guessed URLs returned 404). The auction is undated; the caption places it a few years before August 2011. Wikidata puts the tower in the Cloquet Valley State Forest, which conflicts with a sale of forestry property; ownership should be checked against Saint Louis County or DNR records. Access level is omitted because no current statement was found; the brief's access 'unknown' stands. Commons photo File:Cotton_Lookout_Tower.jpg (CC BY-SA 4.0, uploader Tlkremer) could be added once its direct image URL is confirmed; not added here. Staffing and notable fires were not found.
